My keyboard responds with a delay.
You are describing visible symptoms to a support colleague, without claiming to know the cause. Describe delayed typing.
Reageert is singular present. Met vertraging describes a delayed response, rather than failure to respond at all.
You are describing visible symptoms to a support colleague, without claiming to know the cause. Report a persistent blurry picture.
Blijft takes adjective onscherp for the image's persistent blurry state; there is no infinitive in this sentence.
The bar stays at fifty percent.
You are describing visible symptoms to a support colleague, without claiming to know the cause. Describe the stuck progress bar.
Blijft takes bare infinitive staan. Op vijftig procent describes the progress indicator's level, not a physical standing posture.
The fan makes more noise than usual.
You are describing visible symptoms to a support colleague, without claiming to know the cause. Compare fan noise with normal operation.
Meer lawaai is the object of maakt. Dan normaal compares noise with usual operation, without diagnosing why it is louder.
The text appears twice in the window.
You are describing visible symptoms to a support colleague, without claiming to know the cause. Describe duplicated text in the window.
Verschijnt agrees with de tekst. Dubbel describes duplicated display; in het venster locates it.
The laptop shuts down without warning.
You are describing visible symptoms to a support colleague, without claiming to know the cause. Report a shutdown with no warning.
Uitvallen splits as valt ... uit. Zonder waarschuwing means without warning and is a preposition phrase, not a time expression.
The sound only comes from the left speaker.
You are describing visible symptoms to a support colleague, without claiming to know the cause. Identify the speaker that still produces sound.
Alleen limits the source to de linkerluidspreker. Uit identifies where the sound comes from; it is not the separable particle of komen.
The button does not change colour.
You are describing visible symptoms to a support colleague, without claiming to know the cause. Describe the missing visual response.
Verandert agrees with de knop. Niet van kleur denies a colour change, without asserting the button has no other response.
The window disappeared immediately after the click.
You are describing visible symptoms to a support colleague, without claiming to know the cause. Report what happened just after clicking.
Verdween is singular past of verdwijnen. Meteen na de klik means immediately after the click; this sequence alone does not prove causation.
Part of the text is missing.
You are describing visible symptoms to a support colleague, without claiming to know the cause. Report missing text rather than an empty file.
Er introduces the missing element; een deel van de tekst is the singular subject of ontbreekt. Some text is missing, rather than the entire file being empty.
Where do you see the red border?
You are describing visible symptoms to a support colleague, without claiming to know the cause. Ask where the red border appears.
Waar asks location. Zie precedes informal subject je; de rode rand is the object seen, not the subject.
Does the button respond after a few seconds?
You are describing visible symptoms to a support colleague, without claiming to know the cause. Ask whether the response is delayed.
Reageert precedes singular de knop in this yes/no question. Na een paar seconden asks about a delayed response, not an instant one.
My neighbour at the office has the same delay.
You are checking which people are affected by a workplace problem, keeping the affected scope precise. Add the colleague sitting beside you.
Mijn buurman op kantoor is a singular subject with heeft. Dezelfde vertraging refers to the delay already discussed, without proving the same cause.
How many employees see this warning?
You are checking which people are affected by a workplace problem, keeping the affected scope precise. Ask for an affected-person count.
Hoeveel medewerkers is the plural question subject of zien. Deze waarschuwing is the object; the question counts affected employees.
The accounts department cannot open the invoices.
You are checking which people are affected by a workplace problem, keeping the affected scope precise. Report the department and blocked action.
De boekhouding is a singular department subject with modal kan. Openen remains infinitive and niet denies opening the invoices.
Our intern uses a different network.
You are checking which people are affected by a workplace problem, keeping the affected scope precise. Distinguish the intern's network from yours.
Onze agrees with de stagiair, while singular gebruikt agrees with that intern. Een ander netwerk distinguishes the network, not necessarily the cause of the fault.
The external colleagues are not affected.
You are checking which people are affected by a workplace problem, keeping the affected scope precise. Exclude external colleagues from the impact.
Zijn agrees with plural de externe collega's. Niet getroffen describes their unaffected state in the current fault, not immunity to every problem.
Do all team members get the same message?
You are checking which people are affected by a workplace problem, keeping the affected scope precise. Check whether every member sees identical text.
Krijgen precedes plural alle teamleden. Dezelfde melding asks whether the message is shared by all members, not whether they share an account.
The colleagues in Ghent also report problems.
You are checking which people are affected by a workplace problem, keeping the affected scope precise. Add another office to the scope.
De collega's is plural with melden. In Gent identifies the colleagues, and ook adds their reports to those already mentioned.
There is only one user with this problem.
You are checking which people are affected by a workplace problem, keeping the affected scope precise. State that a single user is affected.
Er introduces the affected person; maar één gebruiker is singular with is. Maar means only here, restricting the count to one.
S=De nachtdienst|PAST=had|O=nog geen last van de storing.
The night shift was not yet affected by the disruption.
You are checking which people are affected by a workplace problem, keeping the affected scope precise. Describe the earlier shift's unaffected state.
Had is singular past with collective de nachtdienst. Nog geen last van means not yet affected at that earlier time; it does not guarantee the shift remained unaffected later.
Which teams are working with this version today?
You are checking which people are affected by a workplace problem, keeping the affected scope precise. Ask which teams use the version today.
Welke teams is the plural question subject of werken. Met deze versie specifies the software version in use today.
In our team, two temporary employees have no access.
You are checking which people are affected by a workplace problem, keeping the affected scope precise. Specify two temporary employees in your team.
Bij ons is fronted, followed by hebben and plural subject twee tijdelijke medewerkers. Geen toegang denies access for those two people.
Reception has not reported anything yet.
You are checking which people are affected by a workplace problem, keeping the affected scope precise. Report the absence of a reception report, not proof of no issue.
Heeft gemeld is perfect. Nog niets means nothing yet; an absence of reports from reception does not establish an absence of faults.
S=Ik|PAST=zag|O=de waarschuwing|G=toen ik het rapport opende.
I saw the warning when I opened the report.
You are reconstructing one particular past event for a support colleague. Explain that the warning appeared to you when you opened the report.
Zag is singular past of zien. Toen links this particular past event to opening the report, unlike als for a condition or repeated occurrence. Opende follows its object in the toen-clause.
Before the move, we did not have this problem.
Last week a colleague used one of several versions. Ask which version they used, using informal je.
Vóór de verhuizing is fronted before past hadden we. Niet denies this problem before the move, without proving that the move caused it.
Which version did you use last week?
You started work only at ten this morning, so you cannot report earlier observations. Explain when you started.
Welke versie is the question object, followed by singular past gebruikte and subject je. Vorige week locates the version use in the past.
I only started at ten o'clock.
You are reconstructing the history of a reported problem and separating earlier events from proven causes. Explain the limit of your personal observation.
Ben begonnen is perfect with zijn. Pas om tien uur means not until ten; the speaker is reporting the late start, not an earlier fault observation.
The error has existed since Monday.
You are reconstructing the history of a reported problem and separating earlier events from proven causes. State an ongoing condition that began Monday.
Bestaat is present for the ongoing error. Al sinds maandag sets Monday as its starting point, where English naturally uses has existed.
During the previous shift, everything was normal.
You are reconstructing the history of a reported problem and separating earlier events from proven causes. Report the previous shift's state.
Was is singular past with alles. Tijdens de vorige dienst places the normal state during the previous shift, not necessarily now.
The user also saw the message last month.
You are reconstructing the history of a reported problem and separating earlier events from proven causes. Report an earlier occurrence last month.
Heeft gezien is perfect with no change to the past time vorige maand. Ook connects this earlier sighting to another occurrence of the message.
At what time did the window disappear?
You are reconstructing the history of a reported problem and separating earlier events from proven causes. Ask when the window disappeared.
Hoe laat asks the clock time. Verdween is singular past with subject het venster; Dutch uses no extra equivalent of did.
Since Tuesday, we have been getting duplicate messages.
You are reconstructing the history of a reported problem and separating earlier events from proven causes. State the starting point of repeated messages.
Sinds dinsdag is fronted before krijgen we. Present krijgen describes repeated duplicate messages continuing from Tuesday.
S=De collega|V=zegt|G=dat het probleem gisteren begon.
The colleague says the problem started yesterday.
You are reconstructing the history of a reported problem and separating earlier events from proven causes. Attribute the onset report to your colleague.
Zegt is present reporting another person's statement. Dat introduces the reported claim, ending in past begon; the speaker attributes rather than independently proves the onset.
S=De printer|AUX=heeft|T=vóór de pauze|O=nog twintig pagina's|PT=geprint.
The printer printed another twenty pages before the break.
You are reconstructing the history of a reported problem and separating earlier events from proven causes. Give evidence of earlier successful printing.
Heeft geprint is perfect. Nog twintig pagina's means another twenty pages here; vóór de pauze places that successful printing before the break.
The exact start time is not yet known.
You are reconstructing the history of a reported problem and separating earlier events from proven causes. Acknowledge that the exact onset remains unknown.
Nog niet bekend is an adjective complement after is. It describes knowledge of the exact start time as currently missing, not a second finite verb.
Every now and then, the warning appears again.
You are describing how often a workplace fault occurs, distinguishing occasional failures from continuous ones. Describe an occasional recurring warning.
Af en toe means every now and then and opnieuw means again. Fronting the frequency phrase gives verschijnt de waarschuwing.
You are describing how often a workplace fault occurs, distinguishing occasional failures from continuous ones. Describe a regular alternate-attempt failure.
Elke tweede poging is a singular subject with mislukt. The scenario intends alternating attempts: the second, fourth and so on fail.
G=Wanneer ik de camera gebruik,|V=wordt|S=het beeld|C=zwart.
When I use the camera, the image turns black.
You are describing how often a workplace fault occurs, distinguishing occasional failures from continuous ones. Name the condition that makes the image black.
Wanneer introduces the recurring condition and ends in gebruik. Main wordt het beeld zwart follows it; wordt plus adjective expresses a change of state, not passive voice.
After five minutes, the application responds again.
You are describing how often a workplace fault occurs, distinguishing occasional failures from continuous ones. Report recovery after five minutes.
Na vijf minuten is fronted before reageert de toepassing. Weer means again, describing restored responsiveness after five minutes.
The disruption is not present continuously.
You are describing how often a workplace fault occurs, distinguishing occasional failures from continuous ones. Clarify that the disruption comes and goes.
Niet voortdurend denies continuous presence of the fault. Aanwezig is an adjective after is; intermittent presence does not mean the fault never happens.
The current interruption is shorter than the one yesterday. Compare yesterday's interruption with this one.
Duurde is singular past with de onderbreking. Langer compares yesterday's duration with the interruption now under discussion.
Does this also happen without a connected camera?
The fault under discussion happens with a camera connected. Ask whether it also happens without a connected camera.
Gebeurt begins the yes/no question with subject dit, referring to the fault. Zonder aangesloten camera asks whether it also happens when no camera is connected.
The image stays clear between the interruptions.
You are describing how often a workplace fault occurs, distinguishing occasional failures from continuous ones. Describe the successful intervals.
Blijft is present and helder is an adjective complement. Tussen de onderbrekingen locates the clear image in the intervals, not during each interruption.
The error has not returned today yet.
You are describing how often a workplace fault occurs, distinguishing occasional failures from continuous ones. Report no recurrence today so far.
Is teruggekomen is perfect with zijn. Nog niet denies recurrence so far today; teruggekomen joins the separable verb's parts.
T=Bij elke nieuwe sessie|V=verschijnt|S=de melding|A=één keer.
In each new session, the message appears once.
You are describing how often a workplace fault occurs, distinguishing occasional failures from continuous ones. Give the per-session frequency.
Bij elke nieuwe sessie gives the repeated setting. Eén keer counts one occurrence in each such session, not one overall.
I note down when the delay occurs.
You are describing how often a workplace fault occurs, distinguishing occasional failures from continuous ones. Say you are recording occurrence times.
Wanneer introduces an embedded when-question ending in optreedt. Noteren means record the times, rather than reproduce or solve the delay.
Under what circumstances does the system remain stable?
You are describing how often a workplace fault occurs, distinguishing occasional failures from continuous ones. Ask about conditions for stable operation.
Onder welke omstandigheden is the opening question phrase, followed by blijft and subject het systeem. Stabiel names the state whose conditions are being checked.
The queue is getting longer and longer.
You are explaining the practical impact of a workplace fault, without confusing inconvenience with total outage. Describe the growing queue.
Wordt plus langer describes becoming longer. Steeds strengthens the developing comparison; this is a growing queue, not a passive action.
Our customers cannot view their appointments.
You are explaining the practical impact of a workplace fault, without confusing inconvenience with total outage. Report a customer-facing loss of visibility.
Kunnen is plural with onze klanten. Niet bekijken denies their ability to view their own appointments, without saying the appointments were deleted.
The internal meeting is not affected by this.
You are explaining the practical impact of a workplace fault, without confusing inconvenience with total outage. Exclude the internal meeting from the impact.
Hier ... van refers to the fault, not a place. Geen last hebben van means be unaffected by; het interne overleg is the singular subject of heeft.
This interruption costs us about twenty minutes.
You are explaining the practical impact of a workplace fault, without confusing inconvenience with total outage. Estimate the time lost to the interruption.
Deze onderbreking is the singular subject of kost. Ons names those losing the time; ongeveer twintig minuten is an approximate cost in time.
As a result, we have missed two calls.
You are explaining the practical impact of a workplace fault, without confusing inconvenience with total outage. Report two missed calls caused by the disruption.
Hebben gemist is perfect. Daardoor states a consequence of the disruption; twee gesprekken means two calls in this scenario.
The colleagues have to enter the data manually.
You are explaining the practical impact of a workplace fault, without confusing inconvenience with total outage. Describe the extra manual work now required.
Moeten is plural with de collega's and takes infinitive invoeren. Handmatig specifies manual entry, rather than automatically processed data.
How much time are we losing because of this delay?
You are explaining the practical impact of a workplace fault, without confusing inconvenience with total outage. Ask for the amount of time lost.
Hoeveel tijd is the question object, while we is the subject of verliezen. Door deze vertraging identifies the cause of the time loss.
S=Ik|V=meld|G=dat de verwerking van betalingen stilligt.
I report that payment processing is at a standstill.
You are explaining the practical impact of a workplace fault, without confusing inconvenience with total outage. Report stopped payment processing.
Dat introduces the report content. De verwerking is singular with stilligt; stilliggen stays joined in the final embedded verb.
S=De fout|V=raakt|O=alleen de weergave,|CONJ=niet|O=de opgeslagen gegevens.
The error only affects the display, not the saved data.
You are explaining the practical impact of a workplace fault, without confusing inconvenience with total outage. Limit the impact to the display.
De fout is singular with raakt. Alleen limits the affected thing to the display; niet de opgeslagen gegevens excludes the saved data from this stated impact.
We can handle fewer requests today.
You are explaining the practical impact of a workplace fault, without confusing inconvenience with total outage. Explain reduced capacity today.
Kunnen takes bare infinitive afhandelen. Minder aanvragen means fewer requests than normal today, rather than no requests at all.
You are explaining the practical impact of a workplace fault, without confusing inconvenience with total outage. Describe the current manageable backlog.
Is agrees with de achterstand. Nog beheersbaar means still manageable now, without promising the backlog will stay that way.
S=De teamleider|V=vraagt|G=of de middagploeg extra hulp nodig heeft.
The team leader asks whether the afternoon shift needs extra help.
You are explaining the practical impact of a workplace fault, without confusing inconvenience with total outage. Report the team leader's question about staffing impact.
Of introduces whether. De middagploeg is singular with final heeft; extra hulp is what that shift may need.
You can view the previous reports.
You are checking what still works during a workplace fault and separating access rights from technical availability. Point out that old reports remain viewable.
Kunt takes bare infinitive bekijken. Wel marks a contrast: viewing previous reports is possible despite the other failure.
The second printer is working normally for now.
You are checking what still works during a workplace fault and separating access rights from technical availability. Report the current state of the alternative printer.
Werkt is singular with de tweede printer. Voorlopig limits the normal operation to the current situation; normaal describes how it operates.
I can still save a local document.
You are checking what still works during a workplace fault and separating access rights from technical availability. Report successful local saving.
Kan takes joined infinitive opslaan. Nog describes remaining local saving, without claiming remote saving also works.
S=De storing|V=heeft|O=geen invloed op onze interne chat.
The disruption has no effect on our internal chat.
You are checking what still works during a workplace fault and separating access rights from technical availability. Exclude internal chat from the disruption.
Heeft agrees with de storing. Geen invloed op excludes an effect on the internal chat in this particular incident.
Do the existing appointments remain visible?
You are checking what still works during a workplace fault and separating access rights from technical availability. Check visibility of appointments already saved.
Blijven precedes plural de bestaande afspraken. Zichtbaar is an adjective complement; the question checks continued visibility, not new appointment creation.
With the cable, the connection stays stable.
You are checking what still works during a workplace fault and separating access rights from technical availability. Report a stable wired connection.
Met de kabel is fronted before blijft de verbinding. The wired setup is the condition for this stable connection.
You are checking what still works during a workplace fault and separating access rights from technical availability. Narrow the remaining failure to sending.
Het verzenden is a nominalised infinitive and singular subject of mislukt. Alleen limits the remaining failure to sending; nog means still.
We can reach the customer by telephone.
You are checking what still works during a workplace fault and separating access rights from technical availability. Offer a working contact method.
Kunnen takes bare infinitive bereiken. De klant is the object reached; via de telefoon gives the working contact method.
You are checking what still works during a workplace fault and separating access rights from technical availability. Contrast a successful backup test with another failure.
Is gelukt is perfect with zijn for a successful test. Wel contrasts this success with another failure; de reservetest is singular.
I note down which functions remain available.
You are checking what still works during a workplace fault and separating access rights from technical availability. Say that you record the functions still working.
Welke functies is the embedded plural subject of blijven. Beschikbaar is the adjective describing those functions; noteer records them without promising repairs.
S=De tijdelijke oplossing|V=is|C=trager|PP=dan de gewone werkwijze.
The temporary solution is slower than the normal procedure.
You are checking what still works during a workplace fault and separating access rights from technical availability. Compare the temporary method with normal work.
Trager is comparative with dan de gewone werkwijze. The temporary method remains usable in this context but is slower than the normal one.
We do not yet have evidence of data loss.
You are checking what still works during a workplace fault and separating access rights from technical availability. State the evidence limit, not a guarantee of no loss.
Nog geen bewijs means no evidence yet. The sentence limits current evidence; it does not prove that no data has been lost.
